people.name: Harold Alexander, 1st Earl Alexander of Tunis
people.nameZh: 第一代突尼斯的亞歷山大伯爵哈羅德·亞歷山大

heading.zh-Hant: 出身與早年
heading.en: Origins and early career

body.zh-Hant: 哈羅德·亞歷山大1891年12月10日生於倫敦。他在哈羅公學受教育，後入桑赫斯特軍事學院，1911年受任愛爾蘭禁衛團軍官；一戰期間他在西線指揮該團一個營，兩度負傷，1915年獲軍功十字勳章。1937年他晉升少將，是當時英軍最年輕的將官。
body.en: Harold Alexander was born in London on 10 December 1891. He was educated at Harrow and then Sandhurst, was commissioned in the Irish Guards in 1911, commanded a battalion of the regiment on the Western Front in the First World War, was wounded twice and won the Military Cross in 1915. Promoted in 1937, he was the youngest general in the British army.

heading.zh-Hant: 二戰初期：敦克爾克、英國本土與緬甸
heading.en: Early Second World War: Dunkirk, home defence and Burma

body.zh-Hant: 1939年大戰爆發時，亞歷山大是少將，指揮第1師。1940年6月他以軍長身分指揮英軍自敦克爾克撤退，其後出任英格蘭南部防務指揮官。1942年3月至8月他任緬甸的最高指揮官；加拿大總督府頁面並稱他其後成為中東總司令。
body.en: At the outbreak of war in 1939 Alexander was a major-general commanding the First Division. As a corps commander he led the British retreat from Dunkirk in June 1940 and then commanded the defence of southern England. He was commander-in-chief in Burma from March to August 1942, and the Governor General of Canada site states that he then became Commander-in-Chief in the Middle East.

heading.zh-Hant: 敦克爾克、中東與地中海戰役（補充）
heading.en: Dunkirk, the Middle East and Mediterranean campaigns (supplement)

body.zh-Hant: 據 EBSCO 研究起點，亞歷山大在1940年敦克爾克撤退中是最後一名自海灘撤離的軍人，其後他的建議促成新的戰鬥操典與總司令部戰鬥學校。1942年他受任英軍中東總司令，在蒙哥馬利協助下擊敗隆美爾麾下的軸心軍；1943年2月出任艾森豪的副總司令，將最後的軸心軍逐出突尼西亞。1944年他任盟軍義大利戰線總司令，同年晉升元帥並任盟軍地中海最高司令；英國國家檔案館目錄載有他以該最高司令身分撰寫、涵蓋1944年12月12日至1945年5月2日的義大利作戰報告。
body.en: According to EBSCO, Alexander was the last soldier evacuated from the beaches at Dunkirk in 1940, and his recommendations afterwards established a new battle drill and a General Headquarters battle school. In 1942 he was appointed commander in chief of British forces in the Middle East and, with Montgomery's assistance, defeated the Axis forces under Rommel; in February 1943 he became deputy commander in chief to Eisenhower and drove the last enemy forces out of Tunisia. In 1944 he became commander in chief of the Allied armies in Italy and, as field marshal, Allied supreme commander in the Mediterranean; The National Archives lists his despatch as Supreme Allied Commander on operations from 12 December 1944 to 2 May 1945.

heading.zh-Hant: 突尼西亞、西西里與義大利戰役
heading.en: Tunisia, Sicily and the Italian campaign

body.zh-Hant: 1943年1月英軍攻佔的黎波里後，亞歷山大主持突尼西亞作戰，並任艾森豪麾下盟軍副指揮；同年7月指揮西西里戰役，秋季入侵義大利。1943年平安夜他接替艾森豪任義大利戰線總指揮，1944年11月任地中海地區總司令。他於1944年晉升元帥，同年攻佔羅馬，1945年5月對西南歐德軍下達無條件投降條件。
body.en: After the fall of Tripoli in January 1943 Alexander directed operations in Tunisia as deputy to Eisenhower; he led the Sicily campaign in July 1943 and the invasion of Italy that autumn. On Christmas Eve 1943 he replaced Eisenhower as commander on the Italian front, and in November 1944 became Allied commander in the Mediterranean. He was promoted field marshal in 1944, took Rome that year, and in May 1945 imposed unconditional surrender terms on the German armies in south-western Europe.

heading.zh-Hant: 加拿大總督、國防大臣與晚年
heading.en: Governor General of Canada, Minister of Defence and later life

body.zh-Hant: 1946年3月1日他受封突尼斯子爵，並出任加拿大總督，任內走遍全國，也探視開赴朝鮮的部隊。1952年初他應邱吉爾之請返英任國防大臣，3月14日晉封突尼斯伯爵；SNL記他任國防大臣的時間為1952至1954年。他於1969年6月16日去世。
body.en: He was created Viscount Alexander of Tunis on 1 March 1946 and served as Governor General of Canada, travelling the country widely and visiting troops leaving for Korea. In early 1952 he returned to London at Churchill’s request to become Minister of Defence and was created Earl Alexander of Tunis on 14 March 1952; the Norwegian encyclopedia dates his defence ministry to 1952–1954. He died on 16 June 1969.

people.name: William Slim, 1st Viscount Slim
people.nameZh: 第一代斯利姆子爵威廉·斯利姆

heading.zh-Hant: 出身與一戰
heading.en: Origins and the First World War

body.zh-Hant: 威廉·斯利姆1891年8月6日生於布里斯托。據挪威大百科，他在第一次世界大戰爆發時以列兵身分入伍，因表現優異很快升為軍官，先後在法國、伊拉克與土耳其達達尼爾一帶作戰；1920年他成為印度軍隊的軍官。
body.en: William Slim was born in Bristol on 6 August 1891. According to the Norwegian encyclopedia he joined up at the outbreak of the First World War as a private, was soon promoted officer for good service, fought in France, Iraq and at the Dardanelles, and in 1920 became an officer in the Indian army.

heading.zh-Hant: 二戰：北非、緬甸與第14集團軍
heading.en: Second World War: North Africa, Burma and the Fourteenth Army

body.zh-Hant: 1940年斯利姆在北非、伊朗與伊拉克作戰。1942年他受命統領緬甸的一個軍，1943年出任第14集團軍司令；他在印緬邊境同兵力占優的日軍進行艱苦的戰役，直到把日軍向東逐出緬甸。
body.en: In 1940 Slim fought in North Africa, Iran and Iraq. In 1942 he was given command of an army corps in Burma and in 1943 became commander of the Fourteenth Army; on the Indian border he fought a hard campaign against superior Japanese forces until he had driven them east and out of Burma.

heading.zh-Hant: 緬甸撤退與第14集團軍戰役
heading.en: The Burma retreat and the Fourteenth Army campaigns

body.zh-Hant: 1942年2月日軍侵入緬甸後，斯利姆受命指揮緬甸第1軍；該軍在惡劣天氣、缺糧缺油的狀況下撤出緬甸。1943年10月起他統領第14集團軍；1944年3至7月，他的部隊在英帕爾與科希馬同日軍激戰，日軍在緬甸的主力於此被擊潰。其後第14集團軍追擊日軍渡過伊洛瓦底江，在密鐵拉與曼德勒再獲勝利，1945年5月進抵仰光。英國國家檔案館另藏有斯利姆以總司令名義撰寫的第14集團軍1943至1944年與1944至1945年作戰紀錄。
body.en: After the Japanese broke into Burma in February 1942, Slim was placed in command of the First Burma Corps, which was bundled out of Burma in atrocious weather with no food, ammunition, gasoline or transport. He commanded the Fourteenth Army from October 1943; from March to July 1944 his troops fought desperately against the Japanese at Imphal and Kohima, where the Japanese army in Burma was broken. The Fourteenth Army then forced its way across the Irrawaddy, won further battles at Meiktila and Mandalay, and reached Rangoon in May 1945. The National Archives also holds accounts of the Fourteenth Army's operations for 1943-1944 and 1944-1945 written by Slim as General Officer Commanding.

heading.zh-Hant: 戰後：參謀長與澳大利亞總督
heading.en: Postwar: chief of staff and Governor-General of Australia

body.zh-Hant: 戰後斯利姆獲任元帥，1948至1952年擔任參謀長，之後出任澳大利亞總督，直到1960年。澳洲總理孟席斯1959年11月12日在議會表示，斯利姆將於次年1月底返英，並稱其任期「非常傑出」。1956年他出版《Defeat into Victory》。
body.en: After the war Slim was made field marshal and was chief of staff from 1948 to 1952, then Governor-General of Australia until 1960. On 12 November 1959 Prime Minister Menzies told the House that Slim would return to England towards the end of January, after what he called a very distinguished term of office. Slim published Defeat into Victory in 1956.

heading.zh-Hant: 出身與早年
heading.en: Origins and early career

body.zh-Hant: 路易·蒙巴頓1900年6月25日生於英格蘭溫莎，是維多利亞女王的曾孫。1917年英王喬治五世將王室的德國姓氏英語化，巴騰堡家族因而改姓蒙巴頓。他1913年進入皇家海軍，1921年任威爾斯親王的副官。
body.en: Louis Mountbatten was born at Windsor, England, on 25 June 1900, a great-grandson of Queen Victoria. In 1917 George V anglicised the German names in the royal family, so the Battenbergs became Mountbatten. He entered the Royal Navy in 1913 and became aide-de-camp to the Prince of Wales in 1921.

heading.zh-Hant: 二戰：納姆索斯撤離與東南亞盟軍最高司令
heading.en: Second World War: Namsos and South East Asia Command

body.zh-Hant: 二戰爆發時，蒙巴頓是驅逐艦支隊的指揮官。1940年他參與納爾維克戰役後英軍自挪威的撤退，並指揮納姆索斯的撤離，也領導數次對德占歐洲的突襲。1942年他升為中將，1943至1946年出任東南亞盟軍最高司令，指揮重奪緬甸的戰役。
body.en: At the outbreak of the Second World War Mountbatten commanded a destroyer flotilla. In 1940 he took part in the British evacuation from Norway after the battle of Narvik, led the evacuation from Namsos and several raids on German-occupied Europe. He became vice-admiral in 1942 and from 1943 to 1946 was Supreme Allied Commander in South East Asia, conducting the campaign that retook Burma.

heading.zh-Hant: 印度總督與印度自治領總督
heading.en: Viceroy of India and Governor-General of India

body.zh-Hant: 1946年8月23日他受封蒙巴頓子爵，1947年10月18日晉封伯爵。1947年2月他成為最後一任印度總督，任至同年8月15日；同日起任印度自治領總督，至1948年6月21日。他促成英屬印度分為印度與巴基斯坦，並說服土邦併入兩國之一；克什米爾衝突時，他建議印度政府提交聯合國安理會。
body.en: He became Viscount Mountbatten of Burma on 23 August 1946 and Earl on 18 October 1947. In February 1947 he became the last Viceroy of India, in office until 15 August that year, and from that date was Governor-General of the Dominion of India until 21 June 1948. He contributed to the partition of British India into India and Pakistan, persuaded the princely states to join one or the other, and in the Kashmir conflict advised India to take the dispute to the UN Security Council.

people.nameZh: 第一代艾倫比子爵埃德蒙·艾倫比

heading.zh-Hant: 出身與早年戰事
heading.en: Origins and early campaigns

body.zh-Hant: 埃德蒙·艾倫比1861年4月23日生於諾丁漢郡的布拉肯赫斯特。他從騎兵起家，先後參加1884至1885年的貝專納蘭戰事、1888年的祖魯蘭戰事與1899至1902年的布爾戰爭；牛津書目專文另記他通過參謀學院，並出任騎兵總監。
body.en: Edmund Allenby was born on 23 April 1861 at Brackenhurst, Nottinghamshire. He began in the cavalry and fought in Bechuanaland in 1884–1885, in Zululand in 1888 and in the Boer War of 1899–1902; the Oxford Bibliographies essay adds that he passed Staff College and became Inspector General of Cavalry.

heading.zh-Hant: 一戰西線：蒙斯撤退與阿拉斯
heading.en: Western Front: the retreat from Mons and Arras

body.zh-Hant: 一戰爆發時艾倫比接掌騎兵師，指揮了1914年自比利時蒙斯的艱難騎兵撤退，之後升任軍長與集團軍司令，最後統領第三集團軍參加阿拉斯戰役。牛津書目專文指出，這場攻勢在初期成功後陷入膠著，艾倫比因未質疑黑格延長攻勢的命令而受批評。
body.en: On the outbreak of the First World War Allenby took command of the Cavalry Division and led the difficult cavalry retreat from Mons in Belgium in 1914; he went on to corps and army command, culminating with the Third Army at the Battle of Arras. The Oxford Bibliographies essay says the offensive bogged down after initial success and that Allenby was criticised for not challenging Haig’s orders to prolong it.

heading.zh-Hant: 巴勒斯坦戰役與耶路撒冷
heading.en: The Palestine campaign and Jerusalem

body.zh-Hant: 1917年6月，首相勞合·喬治派艾倫比赴埃及接掌駐埃及遠征軍，對奧斯曼帝國作戰。他重建該軍，贏得第三次加沙戰役，並在1917年12月攻佔耶路撒冷。他與費薩爾的阿拉伯哈希姆軍協同作戰；其後的戰役擊潰了巴勒斯坦的土耳其軍，英軍進占外約旦、敘利亞與黎巴嫩，勞倫斯於1918年率先頭部隊進入大馬士革。
body.en: In June 1917 Prime Minister Lloyd George sent Allenby to Egypt to command the Egyptian Expeditionary Force against the Ottomans. He rebuilt the force, won the Third Battle of Gaza and captured Jerusalem in December 1917. He worked with the Arab Hashemite army under Prince Feisal; the later campaign crushed the Turkish forces in Palestine and carried British forces into Transjordan, Syria and Lebanon, and Lawrence led the first forces into Damascus in 1918.

heading.zh-Hant: 駐埃及遠征軍：加沙、耶路撒冷與梅吉多
heading.en: Egyptian Expeditionary Force: Gaza, Jerusalem and Megiddo

body.zh-Hant: 艾倫比因與黑格元帥的爭執，於1917年6月被調往中東。他率軍圍攻加沙達兩週，其後追擊至耶路撒冷；1917年12月11日他下馬步行入城。1918年9月他發動梅吉多攻勢，擊潰奧斯曼在黎凡特的三個集團軍，土耳其軍退至大馬士革，終被逐至阿勒坡。牛津大學中東中心的檔案說明另記，他於1918年10月攻占大馬士革與阿勒坡，並於同月30日與土耳其簽訂停戰協定。
body.en: Allenby was transferred to the Middle East in June 1917 after a dispute with Field-Marshal Haig. His forces laid siege to Gaza for two weeks and then pressed on to Jerusalem, which he entered on foot on 11 December 1917. When he launched the Megiddo offensive in September 1918 it shattered the Ottoman line and broke all three armies in the Levant; the Turks fell back to Damascus and were bundled all the way to Aleppo. The Middle East Centre archive description records Damascus and Aleppo taken in October 1918 and an armistice with the Turks signed on 30 October 1918.

heading.zh-Hant: 駐埃及高級專員與晚年
heading.en: High Commissioner in Egypt and later life

body.zh-Hant: 1919年10月7日艾倫比受封梅吉多子爵。他於1919至1925年任英國駐埃及與蘇丹高級專員，其政策使英國對埃及的保護國於1922年終止，埃及走向完全獨立。他於1936年5月14日去世。
body.en: Allenby was created Viscount Allenby of Megiddo on 7 October 1919. He was British High Commissioner in Egypt and Sudan from 1919 to 1925; as a result of his policy the British protectorate over Egypt was lifted in 1922, opening the way to full Egyptian independence. He died on 14 May 1936.

heading.zh-Hant: 青年軍旅：尼羅河、庚子之役與晉升
heading.en: Early career: Nile, Boxer campaign and promotion

body.zh-Hant: 據皇家格林威治博物館的貝蒂檔案簡介，貝蒂1896至1898年在為保住蘇丹歸埃及控制的行動中，因炮艇小艦隊在尼羅河上的作戰表現出色，1898年還在岸上指揮火箭炮連，同年11月晉升中校級的 Commander。次年他隨「巴弗勒」號前往正值義和團之亂的中國，增援天津守軍並率隊出擊圍攻的義和團；1900年11月，年僅29歲的他升為上校級艦長。1910年他升任少將，是百餘年來最年輕的旗官，時年39歲；1911年10月邱吉爾出任海軍大臣後，選他為海軍秘書。
body.en: According to the Royal Museums Greenwich catalogue note on the Beatty papers, between 1896 and 1898 Beatty distinguished himself in operations with a gunboat flotilla on the Nile in the effort to keep the Sudan under Egyptian control, and in 1898 commanded a rocket battery ashore; he was promoted Commander that November. The next year he went to China in the Barfleur during the Boxer rebellion, reinforcing the Tientsin garrison and leading sorties against the besiegers, and in November 1900, aged 29, he was promoted captain. In 1910 he became Rear-Admiral, the youngest flag officer in over a hundred years, at 39; after Churchill became First Lord in October 1911 he chose Beatty as his naval secretary.

heading.zh-Hant: 多格爾沙洲與日德蘭海戰、大艦隊總司令
heading.en: Dogger Bank, Jutland and Grand Fleet command

body.zh-Hant: 皇家格林威治博物館的貝蒂檔案目錄把他的戰時文件分為1915年1月24日的多格爾沙洲海戰、1915至1916年的多格爾沙洲到日德蘭、1916年5月31日的日德蘭海戰，以及「1916至1919年大艦隊總司令」等部分，並寫貝蒂在整個一戰期間在大艦隊的海上作戰中擔任重要角色。1919年他接替韋姆斯任第一海務大臣，直到1927年；任職頭三年，朝野圍繞日德蘭海戰實情的爭議占據了他的海軍部生涯，其中包括哈珀上校編寫的海戰「官方紀錄」最終決定不出版一事。
body.en: The Royal Museums Greenwich catalogue of the Beatty papers divides his wartime papers into the Battle of the Dogger Bank (24 January 1915), Dogger Bank to Jutland (1915–1916), the Battle of Jutland (31 May 1916) and Commander-in-Chief of the Grand Fleet (1916–1919), and says Beatty took a leading part in the Grand Fleet's naval operations throughout the First World War. In 1919 he succeeded Wemyss as First Sea Lord, a post he held until 1927; the controversy over what actually happened at Jutland dominated his first three years at the Admiralty, including the decision not to publish Captain Harper's 'Official Record'.
